originDefinitions.local-extension: Behavior intentionally added by Moluoxixi beyond the upstream baseline.
originDefinitions.upstream-parity: Upstream behavior that Moluoxixi intentionally keeps equivalent across synchronization.

syncPolicyDefinitions.preserve-local: Keep the Moluoxixi behavior and adapt incoming upstream changes around it.
syncPolicyDefinitions.preserve-upstream: Keep this behavior aligned with the upstream baseline unless an explicit local decision replaces it.

contracts.title: Persisted task complexity classification
contracts.reason: Moluoxixi records lightweight or complex task classification, fails closed while it is unclassified, and requires the planning artifacts appropriate to the recorded level.

verification.symbol: fails closed until complexity and manual planning approval are recorded
enforces complex planning artifacts and curated sub-agent context

contracts.title: Small tasks may skip task creation
contracts.reason: When there is no active task, a simple conversation or small task asks only for task-creation consent; declining skips Moluoxixi for the current session.

verification.symbol: keeps the upstream small-task creation opt-out contract

contracts.title: Review-gated spec proposal promotion
contracts.reason: Reusable knowledge enters a proposal inbox first; promotion into formal specs requires an explicit human approval record and rejects stale or concurrently changed targets.

verification.symbol: requires a human approval record before promoting formal knowledge
rejects stale approvals and backs up reviewed replacements

contracts.title: Complete role-local core and CLI packages with guarded publication
contracts.reason: Moluoxixi keeps the complete upstream package trees under collision-resistant names, publishes them only when the synchronized role release pipeline is invoked, and advances the paired npm package version independently when local publication metadata or adaptations change. Published manifests identify the AIRules repository so npm provenance matches the workflow source. Project initialization executes through the local CLI without registry access, and initialized projects receive only the self-contained runtime bundle and updater.

localEvidence.symbol: complete publishable core package manifest with upstream exports and publish metadata
complete publishable CLI package with collision-resistant workspace dependency
bundled channel and memory runtime entry
Moluoxixi tag and core-first release flow
test:publish, verify:publish, and publish:dry-run role workspace gates

verification.symbol: keeps complete role-local packages public, collision-resistant, and publication-capable
stages the complete role and initializes through its role-local CLI

contracts.title: Review-gated three-way Trellis synchronization
contracts.reason: Moluoxixi synchronizes identical package paths from a pinned Trellis baseline, applies collision-resistant package identity transforms, preserves only explicitly recorded local conflicts, and leaves semantic role-native reconciliation plus baseline advancement for human review.
